comment: Was Han right to make Shi-woon risk his life, or did he go too far? 👀 Comment below 👇

segments.say: To see how it got here, go back to a very ordinary *school*, where nothing special happens to anybody.
Shi-woon Lee is a quiet high school kid, and Changho's gang uses him as a *punching* bag every single day.
Every hallway is a trap, and he comes home with a new *bruise* more often than homework.
